messages:
Lina M: FYI follow-up from the PM: INF-7001 still has two open actions (cache shard balancing + runbook). want to assign owners and create handoff notes so oncall can be relieved after rollout.
Carlos V: I can take the shard balancing patch (infra). will need a canary and a small SSH window for verification.
Rhea T: i'll own the runbook + regression harness. will write the exact alert queries and add a playbook step for oncall.
Lina M: great. please declare RACI in the ticket and include rollback criteria. i'll act as I for the rollout.
Carlos V: creating INF-7007 for shard balancing and INF-7008 for the runbook now. linking to INF-7001.
DeployBot: Deployed draft infra branch infra/shard-balance-2026-02 to staging (build 7892).
Rhea T: put me as R for docs & tests, Carlos as E, Lina as I, and Sam as A (I'll ping Sam for approval).
Carlos V: estimated effort 2d + 1d for canary verification. adding feature flag and mem-safety guard.
Lina M: handoff checklist to include in INF-7008 comments:
``
- Owners: Carlos V (infra), Rhea T (docs/tests)
- Canary window: 6h at 2% traffic to canary cluster
- Rollback triggers: p99 latency > baseline+15% OR eviction spike > 2x
- Revert steps: flip flag -> scale down canary -> revert infra commit -> notify oncall
- Post-canary: owner signoff in ticket, schedule handback message to #oncall
```
OncallBot: Reminder: INF-7001 in postmortem pool. Tickets with owners will be removed from weekly triage.
Rhea T: added regression evals to INF-7008 and attached the prompt set that flagged the issue. setting target: no >1% eviction at p99 for 48h after rollout.
Carlos V: assigned INF-7007 to myself and INF-7008 to Rhea. pinging infra-ops for maintenance slot.
Lina M: ok owners set. timeline: start canary in ~7 business days pending infra slot. i'll update the postmortem doc with ticket links and close the loop. thanks.
Sam: (mentioned) I'll review the canary plan once posted and give A signoff if gates pass. :thumbsup:
